|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Anger''' is an [[aura]] [[active skill|skill]] that adds [[fire damage]] to the [[attack]]s and [[spell]]s of the caster and their [[Ally|allies]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== See the [[aura]] page for more details. The aura area of effect radius of a level 1 Anger is 3.6 metre. The area of effect scales with gem level and quality, as well as other source of increase/more area of effect modifiers. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Fire Damage
with Attacks |c1_header = You and nearby allies deal x to y additional Fire Damage with Attacks |c1_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies deal (%d+) to (%d+) additional Fire Damage with Attacks |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = Fire Damage
with Spells |c2_header = You and nearby allies deal x to y additional Fire Damage with Spells |c2_pattern_extract = You and nearby allies deal (%d+) to (%d+) additional Fire Damage with Spells |c2_pattern_value = %d to %d |c3_abbr = Radius |c3_header = +x metres to radius |c3_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c3_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Anger cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Anger: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Anger%" AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Ranger%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related passive skills== The following [[passive skill]]s are related to Anger: {{Passive skill table |q_where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Anger%" AND passive_skills.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Ranger%" AND passive_skills.is_keystone = 0 AND passive_skills.ascendancy_class IS NULL |large=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related modifiers== The following [[modifier]]s are related to Anger:
{{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%Anger%" AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |domain=1 |generation_type=1 }}
These Synthesis implicit are able to find in pre-[[synthesised item]] or added via [[Harvest]] mechanics: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Anger%" AND mods.id LIKE "%SynthesisImplicit%" |stat_text=1 |level=1 |domain=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== The following mods can only be find in legacy item in permanent leagues: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Anger%" AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "3" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Anger%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Anger%" OR items.description LIKE "%your aura%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * Many Skill Gems now display their radius in metres in the Gem description. ** This does not include Anger. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.22.1| * Weapon Range displayed on Melee Weapons and other descriptions that use ranges with values now instead use metres. The reminder text for "Close Range" and the description of Presence range in the Character panel also now use metres. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| *Now grants 16 to 23 additional Fire Damage to Spells at gem level 1 (previously 15 to 21) and 109 to 155 additional Fire Damage to Spells at gem level 20 (previously 99 to 140). This makes the additional Fire Damage apply to Attacks and Spells by the same amount. }} {{Version history table row|3.13.0| * Anomalous Anger now causes you and nearby allies to deal 0.25% increased Burning Damage per 1% gem quality (from 1% per 1% gem quality). * Divergent Anger now grants you and nearby allies 0.05% increased movement speed per 1% gem quality (from 0.25% per 1% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative quality }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Now causes you and nearby allies to deal 16 to 23 additional Fire Damage with Attacks at gem level 1 (from 12 to 21) and 109 to 155 additional Fire Damage with Attacks at gem level 20 (from 83 to 138). * Now causes you and nearby allies to deal 15 to 21 additional Fire Damage with Spells at gem level 1 (from 10 to 16) and 99 to 140 additional Fire Damage with Spells at gem level 20 (from 69 to 110). }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Now instant by default and can therefore be used while moving. * All instant skills now have cooldown 1 second or less. * Instant skills cannot be supported by Spell Echo and will not be cast a second time by similar effects (such as from the Echoing Shrine). }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Now also adds flat fire damage to spells. * The costs on all aura skills with reservation costs has been reduced. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * The damage this aura provides has been reduced at higher levels (from no change at level one, to an 18% reduction in damage at level 20). }} {{Version history table row|1.0.0| * Mana reserved standardized to 60%. Damage has been increased. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * Base mana cost increased by 10 to 50, increasing by 6 per level instead of 5. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.8c| * Anger now counts as a Fire gem. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Anger was added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
